questions.question: List all genres
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Genre].[GenreId], [Genre].[Name] FROM [Genre] ORDER BY [Genre].[Name] ASC, [Genre].[GenreId] ASC

questions.question: How many customers do we have?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 COUNT(*) AS [customer_count] FROM [Customer]

questions.question: Show all employees and their job titles
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Employee].[FirstName] + ' ' + [Employee].[LastName] AS [Full Name], [Employee].[Title] AS [Job Title] FROM [Employee] ORDER BY [Employee].[LastName] ASC, [Employee].[FirstName] ASC

questions.question: List customers from Brazil
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Customer].[FirstName] + ' ' + [Customer].[LastName] AS [Full Name] FROM [Customer] WHERE [Customer].[Country] = 'Brazil' ORDER BY [Customer].[LastName] ASC, [Customer].[FirstName] ASC

questions.question: Which media types are available?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [MediaType].[MediaTypeId], [MediaType].[Name] FROM [MediaType] ORDER BY [MediaType].[Name] ASC

questions.question: Show tracks longer than 10 minutes
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Track].[Name], [Track].[Milliseconds] / 60000.0 AS [DurationMinutes] FROM [Track] WHERE [Track].[Milliseconds] > 600000 ORDER BY [Track].[Name] ASC

questions.question: List business customers (those with a company)
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Customer].[CustomerId], [Customer].[FirstName] + ' ' + [Customer].[LastName] AS [FullName], [Customer].[Company] FROM [Customer] WHERE [Customer].[Company] IS NOT NULL ORDER BY [Customer].[Company] ASC, [Customer].[LastName] ASC, [Customer].[FirstName] ASC

questions.question: Which tracks have no composer listed?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Track].[Name], [Track].[TrackId] FROM [Track] WHERE [Track].[Composer] IS NULL ORDER BY [Track].[Name] ASC, [Track].[TrackId] ASC

questions.question: Show invoices above 20 dollars
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Invoice].[InvoiceId], [Invoice].[CustomerId], [Invoice].[InvoiceDate], [Invoice].[BillingCountry], [Invoice].[Total] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[Total] > 20 ORDER BY [Invoice].[Total] DESC, [Invoice].[InvoiceId] ASC

questions.question: List the video tracks priced at 1.99
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Track].[Name], [Track].[UnitPrice] FROM [Track] INNER JOIN [MediaType] ON [Track].[MediaTypeId] = [MediaType].[MediaTypeId] WHERE [Track].[UnitPrice] = 1.99 AND [MediaType].[Name] LIKE '%Video%' ORDER BY [Track].[Name] ASC

questions.question: How many playlists exist?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 COUNT(*) AS [PlaylistCount] FROM [Playlist]

questions.question: Customers in Canada or the USA
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Customer].[CustomerId], [Customer].[FirstName], [Customer].[LastName], [Customer].[Country] FROM [Customer] WHERE [Customer].[Country] IN ('Canada', 'USA') ORDER BY [Customer].[Country] ASC, [Customer].[LastName] ASC, [Customer].[FirstName] ASC

questions.question: How many tracks are in the catalog?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 COUNT(*) AS [TrackCount] FROM [Track]

questions.question: How many artists do we carry?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 COUNT(*) AS [ArtistCount] FROM [Artist]

questions.question: List the customers who live in Paris
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Customer].[FirstName] + ' ' + [Customer].[LastName] AS [FullName] FROM [Customer] WHERE [Customer].[City] = 'Paris' ORDER BY [Customer].[LastName] ASC, [Customer].[FirstName] ASC

questions.question: How many customers have no state recorded?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 COUNT(*) AS [CustomersWithoutState] FROM [Customer] WHERE [State] IS NULL

questions.question: Show tracks shorter than one minute
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Track].[Name], [Track].[Milliseconds] / 60000.0 AS [DurationMinutes] FROM [Track] WHERE [Track].[Milliseconds] < 60000 ORDER BY [Track].[Name] ASC, [Track].[TrackId] ASC

questions.question: Which albums have the word "Greatest" in the title?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Album].[Title] FROM [Album] WHERE [Album].[Title] LIKE '%Greatest%' ORDER BY [Album].[Title] ASC

questions.question: Invoices billed to London
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Invoice].[InvoiceId], [Invoice].[CustomerId], [Invoice].[InvoiceDate], [Invoice].[BillingCity], [Invoice].[BillingCountry], [Invoice].[Total] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[BillingCity] = 'London' ORDER BY [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] ASC, [Invoice].[InvoiceId] ASC

questions.question: How many invoices are for exactly 0.99?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 COUNT([Invoice].[InvoiceId]) AS [InvoiceCount] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[Total] = 0.99

questions.question: Tracks whose name starts with "Love"
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Track].[Name], [Track].[TrackId] FROM [Track] WHERE [Track].[Name] LIKE 'Love%' ORDER BY [Track].[Name] ASC, [Track].[TrackId] ASC

questions.question: Tracks larger than 500 megabytes
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [TrackId], [Name], [Bytes] FROM [Track] WHERE [Bytes] > 500 * 1024 * 1024 ORDER BY [Bytes] DESC, [Name] ASC

questions.question: Which employees have an IT job title?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Employee].[FirstName] + ' ' + [Employee].[LastName] AS [FullName], [Employee].[Title] FROM [Employee] WHERE [Employee].[Title] LIKE '%IT%' ORDER BY [Employee].[LastName] ASC, [Employee].[FirstName] ASC

questions.question: What is the total playing time of the whole catalog, in hours?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 SUM(CAST([Track].[Milliseconds] AS BIGINT)) / 3600000.0 AS [TotalPlayingTimeHours] FROM [Track]

questions.question: Total revenue per year
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) AS [period_year], SUM([Invoice].[Total]) AS [revenue] FROM [Invoice] GROUP BY YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) ORDER BY YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) ASC

questions.question: How many customers per country?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Country], COUNT(*) AS [customer_count] FROM [Customer] GROUP BY [Country] ORDER BY [customer_count] DESC, [Country] ASC

questions.question: What is the average invoice value?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 AVG([Invoice].[Total]) AS [average_invoice_value] FROM [Invoice]

questions.question: Number of tracks per media type
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [mt].[MediaTypeId], [mt].[Name] AS [media_type], COUNT([t].[TrackId]) AS [tracks] FROM [MediaType] AS [mt] LEFT JOIN [Track] AS [t] ON [t].[MediaTypeId] = [mt].[MediaTypeId] GROUP BY [mt].[MediaTypeId], [mt].[Name] ORDER BY [tracks] DESC, [media_type] ASC

questions.question: Revenue by billing country
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Invoice].[BillingCountry], SUM([Invoice].[Total]) AS [revenue] FROM [Invoice] GROUP BY [Invoice].[BillingCountry] ORDER BY [revenue] DESC

questions.question: How many employees hold each job title?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Employee].[Title], COUNT(*) AS [EmployeeCount] FROM [Employee] GROUP BY [Employee].[Title] ORDER BY [Employee].[Title] ASC

questions.question: Monthly revenue in 2024
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) AS [period_year], MONTH([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) AS [period_month], SUM([Invoice].[Total]) AS [revenue] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] >= '2024-01-01' AND [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]), MONTH([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) ORDER BY YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) ASC, MONTH([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) ASC

questions.question: Which countries have more than 5 customers?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Customer].[Country], COUNT(*) AS [CustomerCount] FROM [Customer] GROUP BY [Customer].[Country] HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY [Customer].[Country] ASC

questions.question: Average track length in minutes per genre
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [g].[Name] AS [genre], AVG(CAST([t].[Milliseconds] AS DECIMAL(18, 4))) / 60000.0 AS [average_track_length_minutes] FROM [Track] AS [t] JOIN [Genre] AS [g] ON [g].[GenreId] = [t].[GenreId] GROUP BY [g].[GenreId], [g].[Name] ORDER BY [g].[Name] ASC

questions.question: How many distinct customers bought something each year?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) AS [Year], COUNT(DISTINCT [Invoice].[CustomerId]) AS [DistinctCustomers] FROM [Invoice] GROUP BY YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) ORDER BY [Year] ASC

questions.question: What is the largest invoice ever issued?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 1 [Invoice].[InvoiceId], [Invoice].[InvoiceDate], [Invoice].[Total] FROM [Invoice] ORDER BY [Invoice].[Total] DESC, [Invoice].[InvoiceId] ASC

questions.question: Total units sold and revenue per quarter of 2023
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) AS [period_year], (MONTH([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) + 2) / 3 AS [period_quarter], SUM([Invoice].[Total]) AS [revenue] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] >= '2023-01-01' AND [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]), (MONTH([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) + 2) / 3 ORDER BY YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) ASC, (MONTH([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) + 2) / 3 ASC

questions.question: What is our total revenue to date?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 SUM([Invoice].[Total]) AS [revenue] FROM [Invoice]

questions.question: How many invoices did we issue in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 COUNT([Invoice].[InvoiceId]) AS [invoice_count] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] >= '2023-01-01' AND [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] < '2024-01-01'

questions.question: Number of albums per artist, most prolific first
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [ar].[ArtistId], [ar].[Name] AS [artist], COUNT([al].[AlbumId]) AS [album_count] FROM [Artist] AS [ar] LEFT JOIN [Album] AS [al] ON [al].[ArtistId] = [ar].[ArtistId] GROUP BY [ar].[ArtistId], [ar].[Name] ORDER BY [album_count] DESC, [ar].[Name] ASC

questions.question: How many tracks cost 0.99 and how many cost 1.99?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Track].[UnitPrice], COUNT(*) AS [TrackCount] FROM [Track] WHERE [Track].[UnitPrice] IN (0.99, 1.99) GROUP BY [Track].[UnitPrice] ORDER BY [Track].[UnitPrice] ASC

questions.question: Average invoice value per billing country
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Invoice].[BillingCountry], AVG([Invoice].[Total]) AS [average_invoice_value] FROM [Invoice] GROUP BY [Invoice].[BillingCountry] ORDER BY [average_invoice_value] DESC

questions.question: Which cities have more than one customer?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Customer].[City], COUNT(*) AS [CustomerCount] FROM [Customer] GROUP BY [Customer].[City] HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY [Customer].[City] ASC

questions.question: How many units have we sold in total?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 SUM([InvoiceLine].[Quantity]) AS [UnitsSold] FROM [InvoiceLine]

questions.question: Revenue by year and quarter
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) AS [Year], DATEPART([QUARTER], [Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) AS [Quarter], SUM([Invoice].[Total]) AS [Revenue] FROM [Invoice] GROUP BY YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]), DATEPART([QUARTER], [Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) ORDER BY [Year] ASC, [Quarter] ASC

questions.question: What is the smallest invoice total?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 MIN([Invoice].[Total]) AS [SmallestInvoiceTotal] FROM [Invoice]

questions.question: What share of our revenue comes from the USA?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 SUM(CASE WHEN [Invoice].[BillingCountry] = 'USA' THEN [Invoice].[Total] ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM([Invoice].[Total]), 0) AS [USARevenueSharePercent] FROM [Invoice]

questions.question: Average number of tracks per invoice
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [rosie_num].[v] * 1.0 / NULLIF([rosie_den].[v], 0) AS [units_per_invoice] FROM (SELECT COUNT([Invoice].[InvoiceId]) AS [v] FROM [Invoice]) AS [rosie_den] CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM([InvoiceLine].[Quantity]) AS [v] FROM [InvoiceLine]) AS [rosie_num]

questions.question: How many countries did we bill in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 COUNT(DISTINCT [Invoice].[BillingCountry]) AS [CountryCount] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] >= '2025-01-01' AND [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] < '2026-01-01'

questions.question: List albums with their artist name
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Album].[Title] AS [AlbumName], [Artist].[Name] AS [ArtistName] FROM [Album] INNER JOIN [Artist] ON [Album].[ArtistId] = [Artist].[ArtistId] ORDER BY [Album].[Title] ASC, [Artist].[Name] ASC

questions.question: Revenue by genre
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Genre].[Name], SUM([InvoiceLine].[UnitPrice] * [InvoiceLine].[Quantity]) AS [line_revenue] FROM [InvoiceLine] LEFT JOIN [Track] ON [Track].[TrackId] = [InvoiceLine].[TrackId] LEFT JOIN [Genre] ON [Genre].[GenreId] = [Track].[GenreId] GROUP BY [Genre].[Name] ORDER BY [line_revenue] DESC

questions.question: Sales by support agent
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [e].[EmployeeId], CONCAT([e].[FirstName], ' ', [e].[LastName]) AS [agent], COUNT([i].[InvoiceId]) AS [invoices], SUM([i].[Total]) AS [revenue] FROM [Employee] AS [e] JOIN [Customer] AS [c] ON [c].[SupportRepId] = [e].[EmployeeId] JOIN [Invoice] AS [i] ON [i].[CustomerId] = [c].[CustomerId] GROUP BY [e].[EmployeeId], [e].[FirstName], [e].[LastName] ORDER BY [revenue] DESC

questions.question: How many tracks does each album by Led Zeppelin have?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Album].[Title], COUNT([Track].[TrackId]) AS [TrackCount] FROM [Album] JOIN [Artist] ON [Album].[ArtistId] = [Artist].[ArtistId] LEFT JOIN [Track] ON [Album].[AlbumId] = [Track].[AlbumId] WHERE [Artist].[Name] = 'Led Zeppelin' GROUP BY [Album].[AlbumId], [Album].[Title] ORDER BY [Album].[Title] ASC

questions.question: Which customers does Jane Peacock support?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 CONCAT([c].[FirstName], ' ', [c].[LastName]) AS [customer_name] FROM [Customer] AS [c] JOIN [Employee] AS [e] ON [c].[SupportRepId] = [e].[EmployeeId] WHERE [e].[FirstName] = 'Jane' AND [e].[LastName] = 'Peacock' ORDER BY [c].[LastName] ASC, [c].[FirstName] ASC

questions.question: Tracks that were never sold
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [t].[TrackId], [t].[Name] FROM [Track] AS [t] LEFT JOIN [InvoiceLine] AS [il] ON [il].[TrackId] = [t].[TrackId] WHERE [il].[InvoiceLineId] IS NULL ORDER BY [t].[Name] ASC

questions.question: Artists that have no albums
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Artist].[ArtistId], [Artist].[Name] FROM [Artist] LEFT JOIN [Album] ON [Album].[ArtistId] = [Artist].[ArtistId] WHERE [Album].[AlbumId] IS NULL ORDER BY [Artist].[Name] ASC

questions.question: Number of tracks on each playlist
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [p].[PlaylistId], [p].[Name] AS [playlist], COUNT([pt].[TrackId]) AS [tracks] FROM [Playlist] AS [p] LEFT JOIN [PlaylistTrack] AS [pt] ON [pt].[PlaylistId] = [p].[PlaylistId] GROUP BY [p].[PlaylistId], [p].[Name] ORDER BY [tracks] DESC, [p].[Name] ASC

questions.question: Who reports to whom?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 CONCAT([e].[FirstName], ' ', [e].[LastName]) AS [employee], [e].[Title], CONCAT([m].[FirstName], ' ', [m].[LastName]) AS [manager] FROM [Employee] AS [e] LEFT JOIN [Employee] AS [m] ON [m].[EmployeeId] = [e].[ReportsTo] ORDER BY [manager] ASC, [employee] ASC

questions.question: Revenue per media type
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [MediaType].[Name], SUM([InvoiceLine].[UnitPrice] * [InvoiceLine].[Quantity]) AS [line_revenue] FROM [InvoiceLine] LEFT JOIN [Track] ON [Track].[TrackId] = [InvoiceLine].[TrackId] LEFT JOIN [MediaType] ON [MediaType].[MediaTypeId] = [Track].[MediaTypeId] GROUP BY [MediaType].[Name] ORDER BY [line_revenue] DESC

questions.question: Which genres has the customer Luis Goncalves bought?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT TOP 501 [Genre].[Name] AS [Genre] FROM [Customer] JOIN [Invoice] ON [Invoice].[CustomerId] = [Customer].[CustomerId] JOIN [InvoiceLine] ON [InvoiceLine].[InvoiceId] = [Invoice].[InvoiceId] JOIN [Track] ON [Track].[TrackId] = [InvoiceLine].[TrackId] JOIN [Genre] ON [Genre].[GenreId] = [Track].[GenreId] WHERE [Customer].[FirstName] = 'Luis' AND [Customer].[LastName] = 'Rojas' ORDER BY [Genre].[Name] ASC

questions.question: For each sales agent, how many customers do they support and what revenue did those customers generate?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [e].[EmployeeId], CONCAT([e].[FirstName], ' ', [e].[LastName]) AS [agent], COUNT(DISTINCT [c].[CustomerId]) AS [customers_supported], COALESCE(SUM([i].[Total]), 0) AS [revenue] FROM [Employee] AS [e] JOIN [Customer] AS [c] ON [c].[SupportRepId] = [e].[EmployeeId] LEFT JOIN [Invoice] AS [i] ON [i].[CustomerId] = [c].[CustomerId] WHERE [e].[Title] = 'Sales Support Agent' GROUP BY [e].[EmployeeId], [e].[FirstName], [e].[LastName] ORDER BY [agent] ASC

questions.question: How many tracks does each genre have?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [g].[Name] AS [genre], COUNT([t].[TrackId]) AS [track_count] FROM [Genre] AS [g] LEFT JOIN [Track] AS [t] ON [t].[GenreId] = [g].[GenreId] GROUP BY [g].[GenreId], [g].[Name] ORDER BY [g].[Name] ASC

questions.question: List the tracks of the album "Let There Be Rock"
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Track].[Name] FROM [Track] INNER JOIN [Album] ON [Track].[AlbumId] = [Album].[AlbumId] WHERE [Album].[Title] = 'Let There Be Rock' ORDER BY [Track].[Name] ASC

questions.question: Which customers has Steve Johnson been assigned?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 CONCAT([Employee].[FirstName], ' ', [Employee].[LastName]) AS [EmployeeName], CONCAT([Customer].[FirstName], ' ', [Customer].[LastName]) AS [CustomerName] FROM [Employee] INNER JOIN [Customer] ON [Customer].[SupportRepId] = [Employee].[EmployeeId] WHERE [Employee].[FirstName] = 'Steve' AND [Employee].[LastName] = 'Johnson' ORDER BY [Customer].[LastName] ASC, [Customer].[FirstName] ASC

questions.question: Revenue per album, top 20
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 20 [Album].[Title], SUM([InvoiceLine].[UnitPrice] * [InvoiceLine].[Quantity]) AS [line_revenue] FROM [InvoiceLine] LEFT JOIN [Track] ON [Track].[TrackId] = [InvoiceLine].[TrackId] LEFT JOIN [Album] ON [Album].[AlbumId] = [Track].[AlbumId] GROUP BY [Album].[Title] ORDER BY [line_revenue] DESC

questions.question: How much revenue did the genre named exactly "Rock" generate?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 SUM([InvoiceLine].[UnitPrice] * [InvoiceLine].[Quantity]) AS [line_revenue] FROM [InvoiceLine] LEFT JOIN [Track] ON [Track].[TrackId] = [InvoiceLine].[TrackId] LEFT JOIN [Genre] ON [Genre].[GenreId] = [Track].[GenreId] WHERE [Genre].[Name] = 'Rock'

questions.question: How many distinct tracks has each customer bought?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [c].[CustomerId], [c].[FirstName] + ' ' + [c].[LastName] AS [CustomerName], COUNT(DISTINCT [il].[TrackId]) AS [DistinctTracksBought] FROM [Customer] AS [c] LEFT JOIN [Invoice] AS [i] ON [i].[CustomerId] = [c].[CustomerId] LEFT JOIN [InvoiceLine] AS [il] ON [il].[InvoiceId] = [i].[InvoiceId] GROUP BY [c].[CustomerId], [c].[FirstName], [c].[LastName] ORDER BY [CustomerName] ASC, [c].[CustomerId] ASC

questions.question: Customers who never placed an order
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [c].[CustomerId], [c].[FirstName], [c].[LastName] FROM [Customer] AS [c] LEFT JOIN [Invoice] AS [i] ON [i].[CustomerId] = [c].[CustomerId] WHERE [i].[InvoiceId] IS NULL ORDER BY [c].[LastName] ASC, [c].[FirstName] ASC

questions.question: Albums that have no tracks
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Album].[AlbumId], [Album].[Title] FROM [Album] LEFT JOIN [Track] ON [Track].[AlbumId] = [Album].[AlbumId] WHERE [Track].[TrackId] IS NULL ORDER BY [Album].[Title] ASC, [Album].[AlbumId] ASC

questions.question: How many tracks did Iron Maiden record?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 COUNT([Track].[TrackId]) AS [TrackCount] FROM [Artist] JOIN [Album] ON [Album].[ArtistId] = [Artist].[ArtistId] JOIN [Track] ON [Track].[AlbumId] = [Album].[AlbumId] WHERE [Artist].[Name] = 'Iron Maiden'

questions.question: For each manager, how many people report to them directly?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Manager].[EmployeeId], [Manager].[FirstName] + ' ' + [Manager].[LastName] AS [ManagerName], COUNT([Report].[EmployeeId]) AS [DirectReportCount] FROM [Employee] AS [Manager] LEFT JOIN [Employee] AS [Report] ON [Report].[ReportsTo] = [Manager].[EmployeeId] GROUP BY [Manager].[EmployeeId], [Manager].[FirstName], [Manager].[LastName] ORDER BY [ManagerName] ASC, [Manager].[EmployeeId] ASC

questions.question: Which artists appear on the playlist "Grunge"?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT TOP 501 [ar].[Name] AS [artist] FROM [Playlist] AS [p] JOIN [PlaylistTrack] AS [pt] ON [pt].[PlaylistId] = [p].[PlaylistId] JOIN [Track] AS [t] ON [t].[TrackId] = [pt].[TrackId] JOIN [Album] AS [al] ON [al].[AlbumId] = [t].[AlbumId] JOIN [Artist] AS [ar] ON [ar].[ArtistId] = [al].[ArtistId] WHERE [p].[Name] = 'Grunge' ORDER BY [ar].[Name] ASC

questions.question: Revenue per sales agent per year
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [e].[EmployeeId], CONCAT([e].[FirstName], ' ', [e].[LastName]) AS [agent], YEAR([i].[InvoiceDate]) AS [sales_year], SUM([i].[Total]) AS [revenue] FROM [Employee] AS [e] JOIN [Customer] AS [c] ON [c].[SupportRepId] = [e].[EmployeeId] JOIN [Invoice] AS [i] ON [i].[CustomerId] = [c].[CustomerId] WHERE [e].[Title] = 'Sales Support Agent' GROUP BY [e].[EmployeeId], [e].[FirstName], [e].[LastName], YEAR([i].[InvoiceDate]) ORDER BY [sales_year] ASC, [revenue] DESC

questions.question: Which genre is the most popular in each country?
Tracks that are on more than three playlists
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Track].[TrackId], [Track].[Name], COUNT(DISTINCT [PlaylistTrack].[PlaylistId]) AS [PlaylistCount] FROM [Track] INNER JOIN [PlaylistTrack] ON [Track].[TrackId] = [PlaylistTrack].[TrackId] GROUP BY [Track].[TrackId], [Track].[Name] HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT [PlaylistTrack].[PlaylistId]) > 3 ORDER BY [Track].[Name] ASC, [Track].[TrackId] ASC

questions.question: Adding up the catalog price of the track on every invoice line, one price per line sold, what is the total?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 SUM([t].[UnitPrice]) AS [TotalCatalogPrice] FROM [InvoiceLine] AS [il] JOIN [Track] AS [t] ON [t].[TrackId] = [il].[TrackId]

questions.question: What is the average length in milliseconds of the tracks sold, counting a track once for each invoice line it appears on?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 AVG(CAST([t].[Milliseconds] AS DECIMAL(18, 2))) AS [AverageTrackLengthMilliseconds] FROM [InvoiceLine] AS [il] JOIN [Track] AS [t] ON [t].[TrackId] = [il].[TrackId]

questions.question: How many units were sold per playlist? Show the playlist name and the units.
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [p].[Name] AS [playlist], SUM([il].[Quantity]) AS [units_sold] FROM [Playlist] AS [p] LEFT JOIN [PlaylistTrack] AS [pt] ON [pt].[PlaylistId] = [p].[PlaylistId] LEFT JOIN [InvoiceLine] AS [il] ON [il].[TrackId] = [pt].[TrackId] GROUP BY [p].[PlaylistId], [p].[Name] ORDER BY [p].[Name] ASC, [p].[PlaylistId] ASC

questions.question: Show invoices from 2025
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Invoice].[InvoiceId], [Invoice].[CustomerId], [Invoice].[InvoiceDate], [Invoice].[BillingCountry], [Invoice].[Total] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] >= '2025-01-01' AND [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] < '2026-01-01' ORDER BY [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] ASC, [Invoice].[InvoiceId] ASC

questions.question: Invoices issued in March 2023
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Invoice].[InvoiceId], [Invoice].[CustomerId], [Invoice].[InvoiceDate], [Invoice].[Total] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] >= '2023-03-01' AND [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] < '2023-04-01' ORDER BY [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] ASC, [Invoice].[InvoiceId] ASC

questions.question: How much did we sell last year?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 SUM([Invoice].[Total]) AS [Revenue] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] >= '2025-01-01' AND [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] < '2026-01-01'

questions.question: Invoices between June and August 2024
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [InvoiceId], [InvoiceDate], [CustomerId], [Total] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [InvoiceDate] >= '2024-06-01' AND [InvoiceDate] < '2024-09-01' ORDER BY [InvoiceDate] ASC, [InvoiceId] ASC

questions.question: Revenue in the fourth quarter of 2022
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 SUM([Invoice].[Total]) AS [Revenue] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] >= '2022-10-01' AND [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] < '2023-01-01'

questions.question: Which customers bought in 2021 but not in 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [c].[CustomerId], CONCAT([c].[FirstName], ' ', [c].[LastName]) AS [CustomerName] FROM [Customer] AS [c] WHERE [c].[CustomerId] IN (SELECT [i].[CustomerId] FROM [Invoice] AS [i] WHERE [i].[InvoiceDate] >= '2021-01-01' AND [i].[InvoiceDate] < '2022-01-01') AND [c].[CustomerId] NOT IN (SELECT [i].[CustomerId] FROM [Invoice] AS [i] WHERE [i].[InvoiceDate] >= '2022-01-01' AND [i].[InvoiceDate] < '2023-01-01') ORDER BY [c].[LastName] ASC, [c].[FirstName] ASC, [c].[CustomerId] ASC

questions.question: Employees hired before 2003
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Employee].[EmployeeId], [Employee].[FirstName] + ' ' + [Employee].[LastName] AS [FullName], [Employee].[Title], [Employee].[HireDate] FROM [Employee] WHERE [Employee].[HireDate] < '2003-01-01' ORDER BY [Employee].[HireDate] ASC, [Employee].[LastName] ASC, [Employee].[FirstName] ASC

questions.question: What was the first purchase date of each customer?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 [Customer].[CustomerId], [Customer].[FirstName] + ' ' + [Customer].[LastName] AS [CustomerName], MIN([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) AS [FirstPurchaseDate] FROM [Customer] INNER JOIN [Invoice] ON [Invoice].[CustomerId] = [Customer].[CustomerId] GROUP BY [Customer].[CustomerId], [Customer].[FirstName], [Customer].[LastName] ORDER BY [Customer].[LastName] ASC, [Customer].[FirstName] ASC

questions.question: Invoices issued on weekends in 2024
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 COUNT(*) AS [InvoiceCount] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [InvoiceDate] >= '2024-01-01' AND [InvoiceDate] < '2025-01-01' AND DATEPART([WEEKDAY], [InvoiceDate]) IN (1, 7)

questions.question: Compare revenue of 2024 with 2025
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) AS [sales_year], SUM([Invoice].[Total]) AS [revenue] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] >= '2024-01-01' AND [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR([Invoice].[InvoiceDate]) ORDER BY [sales_year] ASC

questions.question: How many invoices were issued in the first half of 2024?
questions.sql: SELECT TOP 501 COUNT([Invoice].[InvoiceId]) AS [invoice_count] FROM [Invoice] WHERE [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] >= '2024-01-01' AND [Invoice].[InvoiceDate] < '2024-07-01'

questions.question: Revenue in December 2024

questions.question: Which month of 2023 had the highest revenue?

questions.question: Year over year revenue growth
When did each customer last buy something?

questions.question: Customers who have not purchased anything since the start of 2025

questions.question: Who is our longest serving employee?

questions.question: Number of invoices per weekday

questions.question: Revenue in the last quarter of 2025 compared with the last quarter of 2024

questions.question: Using a WITH clause that joins invoices to their lines for tracks of the genre named exactly "Rock", what is the sum of the invoice totals of those invoices?
questions.sql: WITH [RockInvoices] AS (SELECT DISTINCT [i].[InvoiceId], [i].[Total] FROM [Invoice] AS [i] JOIN [InvoiceLine] AS [il] ON [il].[InvoiceId] = [i].[InvoiceId] JOIN [Track] AS [t] ON [t].[TrackId] = [il].[TrackId] JOIN [Genre] AS [g] ON [g].[GenreId] = [t].[GenreId] WHERE [g].[Name] = 'Rock') SELECT TOP 501 SUM([RockInvoices].[Total]) AS [invoice_total_sum] FROM [RockInvoices]
